race.description: Christmas Party Raceday Friday 11th December Mdn Plate
race.comment: CELESTIAL BLUE (2) was prominent at the turn and finished third last start at the first run back from a spell over 1000m at Pakenham, beaten 2 lengths. Stepping up a level this time but on his best form he is capable of testing his rivals. RESONANT (5) did very well to fill a minor placing when resuming at Pakenham but raced below expectations last time over 1000m at Bendigo, finishing sixth and beaten 1.5 lengths. Needs to be at his best to beat this field but he can win if at his best. SUPERWILL (8) will find this much more suitable than the two runs to date and has been gelded since. Big improver. TIZ THE TYCOON (9) is one of a number of first-starters who have trialled well and has drawn the best of them, so warrants respect.
